'''Mitsumi's Infernape''' (Japanese: '''ミツミのゴウカザル''' ''Mitsumi's Goukazaru'') is a [[first partner Pokémon]] owned by [[Mitsumi]] in the [[Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!]] manga.

==History==
[[File:Mitsumi Chimchar.png|thumb|200px|left|As a Chimchar]]
[[File:Mitsumi and Infernape.png|thumb|left|200px|Infernape and Mitsumi]]
Sometime prior to the [[DPA01|first chapter]], Mitsumi received Infernape when it was a Chimchar from [[Professor Rowan]]. Professor Rowan gave her Chimchar to teach her that Pokémon were her friends. Chimchar then witnessed {{p|Feebas}}’s [[Evolution]] into Milotic. Sometime later, it evolved into Monferno and then into Infernape.

Infernape made its actual debut in ''[[DPA06|Beauty Contest: The Pokémon Super Contest!!]]'' where it and Mitsumi had participated in the [[Rank (Contest)|Master Rank]] [[Pokémon Super Contest]] in the [[Beautiful (condition)|Beauty]] [[Contest condition|segment]]. Infernape started with {{m|Mach Punch}} and then followed with {{m|Fire Spin}} in which she went overboard on Fire Spin as it burned part of the [[Contest Hall]].

In ''[[DPA08|Team Galactic's Conspiracy, Revealed!!]]'', Infernape participated in a [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]] alongside her {{p|Leafeon}} against [[Jupiter]]'s {{p|Golbat}} and [[Saturn's Toxicroak]]. Their battle continued in ''[[DPA09|Challenge! The Fortress Of Steel!!]]''. As Leafeon used {{m|Sunny Day}}, Infernape launched Fire Spin at Toxicroak, with the move being stronger because of Sunny Day. After Leafeon got overpowered by Golbat's {{m|Air Slash}}, Infernape was left standing. The battle did not continue as Cyrus ordered Jupiter and Saturn to retreat.

In ''[[DPA16|Team Galactic's Ultimate Warrior]]'', after [[Hareta]] found out that Mitsumi is a member of Team Galactic, Infernape snuck behind Hareta and sent him crashing to a wall in order to force him into a battle. Infernape then threw [[Byron]] into a [[Warp panel|Warp Panel]]. As Hareta and Mitsumi began their battle, Infernape began with a {{m|Focus Blast}} which was aimed at {{TP|Hareta|Regigigas}} and then followed up with {{m|Close Combat}} as the smoke occurred. However, Infernape ended up hitting {{p|Kadabra}} instead of Regigigas as Kadabra’s {{m|Skill Swap}} allowed it and Regigigas to switch Abilities, giving Regigigas a chance to escape on the ceiling.

In ''[[DPA17|Clash! Hareta vs. Mitsumi!!]]'', Hareta was about to use his {{p|Onix}} against Infernape but Leafeon defeated it before he had the chance to do so. Infernape was then shown defeating Hareta's {{p|Lucario}}. It then roasted Hareta with Fire Spin. As Hareta was about to have {{TP|Hareta|Luxio}} use {{m|Thunder}}, Infernape emerged from underground and quickly defeated {{p|Luxio}}. After Hareta was down to Piplup, Regigigas, and himself, Infernape attempted to strike Piplup but Hareta blocked Infernape’s attack and then had Piplup use {{m|Hydro Pump}}, taking it out.

In ''[[DPA23|A New Battle Begins!]]'', Infernape was the first Pokémon sent out against [[Cynthia]] where it went up against her {{TP|Cynthia|Garchomp}} Both sides used {{m|Overheat}} and {{m|Giga Impact}} and then were substituted for {{p|Electivire}} and Lucario, respectively. Infernape was sent out again later in the match where it used Focus Blast on Garchomp. As Garchomp dodged, the Focus Blast strayed over to where [[Koya]] was but he was able to protect himself with {{p|Metagross}}. 

In ''[[DPA27|A Surprise Visit from Hareta's Father!]]'', Infernape fought against Team Galactic’s Aggron and won. In ''[[DPA28|Look for Giratina!]]'', Infernape worked with Hareta's {{p|Luxray}} and Jun's Staraptor to battle Team Galactic’s Golbat.

In ''[[DPA34|Koya's Sad Reunion]]'', Infernape, alongside Jupiter's {{p|Crobat}} and [[Mars's Purugly]], was revealed to have taken out [[Charon]]'s horde of Team Galactic Grunts. In ''[[DPA37|Gathering of the Legendary Pokémon!]]'', Infernape took on {{p|Giratina}} as Giratina teamed with Hareta in a friendly battle.

==Personality and characteristics==
Infernape was shown to have a strong bond with Mitsumi, as evidenced with its time in the Master Rank of the Pokémon Super Contest. When Mitsumi reverted back to her time as a member of Team Galactic, Infernape went along as it took orders without any hesitation even though its time as a Chimchar and Professor Rowan's teachings was what led Mitsumi into treating Pokémon as friends instead of tools.
